usedFor: Shopify takes the payment, and Uscreen holds your video members when “Order Paid” runs “Create User”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create User” in Uscreen
bestTemplate.why: A paid order creates the buyer’s Uscreen account, so access follows payment.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” also triggers, so use “Order Paid” alone to avoid creating a user twice.
